name: Seated Cable Row — Wide Overhand Grip
description: A seated cable row performed with a wide overhand grip using a straight bar. This grip orientation shifts the loading emphasis from the lats to the middle and upper traps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids compared to a close neutral-grip row, targeting the mid-scapular muscles more directly.

execution.starting_position: Sit at a cable row station with feet on the foot rests and knees slightly bent. Hold a wide straight bar with an overhand grip.
execution.setup_instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low cable pulley. Sit down, place feet on the foot rests, and grip the bar wide with an overhand grip.
steps: Step 1: Keep the torso upright and brace the core throughout.
Step 2: Pull the bar toward the upper abdomen, driving the elbows out wide to the sides.
Step 3: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the peak of the row.
Step 4: Return under control to full arm extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the pull. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Using momentum by swinging the torso
Not squeezing the shoulder blades at the top
safety_considerations: A wider grip means the elbows flare out — this is intentional for mid-trap targeting
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full arm extension at the front. Bar pulled to the upper abdomen with shoulder blades retracted at the back.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top
